cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll come for dinner so we can reconnect. I'll leave at ten. Please plan backwards from that, not from whenever you're ready to eat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to discuss why you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Put that before pudding. No, not over coffee; difficult subjects need time to settle before I go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I'm still upset at ten?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we schedule another dinner. Please don't call that walking out again; it's ending on time so I'm willing to come back.
